create_CocoDetection_dataset: create a CocoDetection dataset instance with a root directory and COCO annotation JSON file
cache_images_method: cache all COCO dataset images into memory for faster repeated access during training
get_image_method: retrieve a single COCO image by file path from cache or disk as an RGB PIL Image
getitem_method: get a dataset item by index returning a tuple of the image and its COCO annotations
len_method: get the total number of images in the COCO dataset by calling len on the dataset
